I am **Nikitas Rafael Nikitas**, a Senior Data Scientist based in Greece. I work with predictive modelling, statistical reasoning and production machine learning.

## Professional focus

I enjoy turning a clear question into an analysis, comparing models against useful baselines and explaining what the evidence supports.

My focus spans feature engineering, experimentation, explainable ML and the pipelines that make a model usable. This portfolio brings together public analyses, notebooks and applications.

## Areas of practice

| Area | What I work with |
|---|---|
| Predictive modelling | Python, SQL, LightGBM, CatBoost, XGBoost, feature engineering, SHAP |
| Statistical reasoning | A/B testing, causal inference, uncertainty, model evaluation and decision metrics |
| ML systems | FastAPI, Airflow, reproducible pipelines and data validation |
| AI applications | Evidence retrieval, grounded explanations, evaluation and fallback behaviour |

## Selected public work

- [Beyond FIFA Potential](studies/fifa-hidden-gems/): historical scouting rankings and individual explanations.
- [Agora Match](studies/agora-match/): a synthetic football intelligence application with an inspectable evidence layer.
- [Football Forecasting Lab](studies/football-forecasting/): probabilistic score models, chronological backtesting and league simulation.
